item.description: En España, la siesta es casi una institución cultural que supone un pequeño placer diario que tradicionalmente se ha asociado con un buen descanso y una recarga de energía. item.title: Germany’s far-right AfD eyes historic first in state election
item.description: In Saxony-Anhalt, AfD – Germany's far-right party – is polling at 40% or more of voting intentions, just days ahead of the regional election on 6 September 2026. If the AfD wins an absolute majority of seats, it could soon be in charge here. It would be the first time since 1945 that a far-right party has led a German region. To get there, the party is banking on the promise of a return to "the Germany of old", leaning on East German symbols such as Simson mopeds and retro aesthetics.
